india.one_line: India sees major AI infrastructure rollout, fresh startup funding, and a defence AI partnership.

themes.title: Tata Communications builds AI fibre network
themes.text: Tata Communications will spend up to $450 million to construct about 10,000 km of high‑speed fibre linking AI data‑centre corridors, starting with the Mumbai‑Pune‑Hyderabad‑Chennai route.

stories.headline: Tata Communications to invest $450 million in 10,000 km AI network in India
Tata Communications to spend $450 million on 10,000 km AI‑ready fibre network in India

themes.title: New AI startup funding rounds
themes.text: Nvidia led a $14 million Series B round for Indian startup Simplismart, while Unacademy co‑founders launched a ₹700 crore fund, Longshot Capital, to back AI and deep‑tech startups.

stories.headline: Nvidia backs Indian startup Simplismart with $14 million to cut AI GPU costs
Unacademy founders launch ₹700 cr AI and deeptech fund Longshot Capital

themes.title: Defence ministry partners with Sarvam AI
themes.text: India's Ministry of Defence signed a five‑year MoU with Sarvam AI to develop and deploy AI applications for the Army, Navy and Air Force, covering decision support, target acquisition and data fusion.

stories.headline: India's Ministry of Defence signs AI partnership with Sarvam
